description: Legacy releasedBag frames, as a SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of the rounded frame sequence (time releaseAt + k/60, k < count) plus readable sample frames, (misses with a recorded touch, direct shots, constant-acceleration path) generated from the source commit before the presentation-slide change. Recordings: presentation-slide-0..11 (steady/bold alternating) and docs/showcase-recording.json. Release frames: Lab-captured performance releases; the constant-acceleration path drops flatten. Performance-release hole cases stop before contactAt (the post-contact drop and occlusion gating are the intended change).
